sloka: मन्त्रिपुत्रान् हताञ्छ्रुत्वा समरे लघुविक्रमान् ।पञ्च सेनाग्रगाञ्छूरान् प्रेषयमास रावणः ।। ५.५८.१२१ ।।।।
transliteration: mantriputrān hatāñchrutvā samare laghuvikramān ।pañca senāgragāñchūrān preṣayamāsa rāvaṇaḥ ।। 5.58.121 ।।।।

translations.english: "I sent all of them to the abode of Yama with just an iron bar. Having heard about the death of the less powerful ones, Ravana sent five heroic army generals.
